name: flowbit-platform
description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform with n8n workflow integration

scripts.dev:local: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:tickets"
scripts.build:local: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:tickets
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:tickets
scripts.seed:docker: docker-compose exec backend npm run seed
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:tickets
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:backend -- --fix && npm run lint:frontend -- --fix && npm run lint:tickets -- --fix
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend && npm run format:tickets
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend-shell && npm install && cd ../frontend-tickets && npm install
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && npm run clean:node_modules
scripts.deps:check: npm audit && cd backend && npm audit && cd ../frontend-shell && npm audit && cd ../frontend-tickets && npm audit
scripts.deps:update: npm update && cd backend && npm update && cd ../frontend-shell && npm update && cd ../frontend-tickets && npm update
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run seed
scripts.reset: npm run clean:all && npm run setup
scripts.ci: npm run install:all && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build:local
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && npm run docker:prod
scripts.deploy:prod: echo 'Production deployment - implement your deployment strategy'
scripts.health: curl -f http://localhost:3001/health && curl -f http://localhost:3000/health && curl -f http://localhost:3002/health

author: FlowBit Platform Team
